accuracyFlags: Says 'four campsite categories' (Basic, Standard, Serviced, Great Walk) but the FAQ then refers to 'Standard and Scenic' sites: DOC's own categories include Scenic, so the intro count and list omit a tier. Source: https://www.doc.govt.nz/parks-and-recreation/places-to-stay/stay-at-a-campsite/facilities-and-fees/. Remaining flags on this page are not yet official-source adjudicated.]
'roughly 950 huts' vs bundled DOC data of 927 huts (product-facts.json, 2026-08-24): align with the data or DOC's current figure.
Fee statements generic (no 2026 dollar figures, no official source dated).
Query intent is mostly navigational DOC booking ('doc hut bookings'); the page cannot win those so CTR stays low.
